thread:
Sam (CS): quick heads-up — HeliosHealth's dedicated pool (helios-prod) spiked to ~94-97% saturation overnight; p50 latency blipped around 02:05 UTC.
Kai (Ops): do we have queue depth and 24h GPU-hours delta?
Sam (CS): queue depth peaked 46, 3h rolling avg ~20. GPU hours +19% vs weekly baseline. They kicked a personalization rollout + nightly validation sweep at same time.
pool-bot: [alert] pool:helios-prod saturation >90% for 9h — suggested actions: temporary +1 reserved unit or throttle non-critical queues.
Tara (SRE): looking at logs — KV-cache warmups + multiple validation jobs (seq_len=1280) started at 02:02Z, validation queue had no preemptible flag. snippet:
```
2025-07-08T02:02:11Z helios-prod GPU3 load 96% seq_len 1280 batch 5
2025-07-08T02:02:12Z job validation id=val-440 queue=nightly-validation
```
Kai (Ops): can we flip nightly-validation to preemptible and add a soft max_concurrent? low-risk and fast.
Rohan (AM): I'll message the customer about shifting validation to an agreed off-peak window and ask if a temporary +1 reserve is acceptable for 48h. Need to know cost impact to explain.
Tara (SRE): applying preemptible flag now. PATCH:
```
PATCH /pools/helios-prod/config
{ "job_priority_override": {"queue":"nightly-validation","priority":"background","preemptible":true} }
```
Tara (SRE): done. queue depth dropping 46 -> 17 in ~8 minutes. GPU saturation down to ~67%.
pool-bot: [info] autoscale suggestion: +1 reserved unit reduces est saturation to ~52% but adds ~24 reserved GPU hours/day.
Sam (CS): customer reported p50 latency 130ms -> 240ms and error-rate small jump 0.5% -> 1.7% during the spike. Tagging renewal-risk for QBR if this happens during their audit week.
Kai (Ops): action items: 1) keep nightly-validation preemptible (owner: Tara, ETA 30m), 2) enforce soft quota max_concurrent=10 (owner: Kai, ETA 24h), 3) decide on +1 reserved for 48h (owner: Rohan/Sam, ETA 2h).
Rohan (AM): pinged infra lead in #accounts-helios, proposed off-peak validation 01:00-07:00 UTC + temporary +1 reserve. Will post customer ack here.
Sam (CS): will add note to weekly account health doc and include renewal-risk flag for QBR. Reopen if latency or error-rate resurfaces. :thumbsup:
